mentions.name: Mobile multiplexer
mentions.description: A mobile multiplexer app with good scrolling, easy composing, simple hotkey use, file sharing, and many quality-of-life features, designed for daily use on the go and including support for the herdr-tui protocol.
mentions.problem: Every existing mobile multiplexer the author tried was either too old-fashioned or low quality.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a mobile multiplexer because every one I tried was either too old-fashioned or low quality.

Now I've built a great app with good scrolling, good composing, simple use of hotkeys, file sharing, and many, many QoL features. I'm really using it on the go almost daily across two months now.
